scope: One frozen pretrained-model reference router for the unchanged V5 six-operation contract. No numeric graph or executor is changed; no distillation or compact-model training is performed.
selection: No held-driven selection, prompt revision, threshold fitting or retry. Freeze all runtime/prompt/protocol sources before the independent evaluator supplies unlabeled requests.
training_material: V5 contracts.py and training_language.py at 332d8156d081e22405450dd607023689f68f03e1; nine examples instantiate public training templates. The broader V6 source protocol and semantic cue source were inspected only for the declared contract.
input: Exactly utterance, series_name, date; existing V5 character/date limits; no intent, family, row ID, answer or hidden metadata is accepted.
model_identity_limit: A provider model identifier does not pin immutable weights, serving revision, or sampling defaults. Returned model metadata and complete usage are recorded when supplied.
recovery: Only replay retained local response bytes under the original admission identity. Unknown attempts are not sent again and are not credited as correct OOD rejections. No provider deduplication guarantee is inferred from the idempotency header.
grading: Independent evaluator owns labels. Use the predeclared coverage >=0.80 and OOD false-acceptance <=0.05 gates, report wrong known accepts and operational unknowns separately, and include every attempted call in cost. An endpoint success code alone is not a semantic pass.
cost: Record every raw request and SSE, exact provider response ID, usage, per-request wall time and total local client CPU. Missing token usage remains unknown; external model CPU, memory, training and weights are unmeasured. This candidate cannot establish a lightweight local Cell improvement.
controls: Run unchanged frozen V5, V6 and deterministic serving processes on exactly the same unlabeled input file; an oracle/codec control is a separate non-language ceiling and must not supply task IDs to this router.
